lines.zh: 炙热咆哮震天响，火焰吞噬大地狂。
lines.en: Roaring flames consume the land, blazing and fierce.

lines.zh: 灼热身躯迈步来，脚下尘土化灰埃。
lines.en: Heat radiates as it strides, turning dust to ash.

lines.zh: 熔岩之心跳动快，炽热气息令人颤。
lines.en: Its molten core beats fast, its heat an intimidating presence.

lines.zh: 烈焰之手挥动烈，火舌舔舐荒地裂。
lines.en: Fiery hands reach out, scorching the cracked earth.

lines.zh: 怒火中燃烧不息，火焰洪流吞没地。
lines.en: In unending rage, it spews fire, engulfing the land.

lines.zh: 熔炉巨兽步履重，地裂火海任它行。
lines.en: The furnace beast strides heavily, leaving fissures and fire in its wake.

lines.zh: 火焰吞噬周遭物，余烬随风飘散去。
lines.en: Flames consume all around, ash carried by the wind.

lines.zh: 灼热目光扫视远，地表万物难逃眼。
lines.en: Its searing gaze scans far and wide, nothing escapes its sight.

lines.zh: 熔岩之息喷薄出，高温炙烤大地热。
lines.en: Molten breath erupts, searing the earth with heat.

lines.zh: 怒焰狂舞天际间，熔炉巨兽显威严。
lines.en: Raging flames dance in the sky, the furnace beast in full display.

lines.zh: 熔炉巨兽踏荒原，灰烬遮天
lines.en: The Furnace Beast treads the waste, ash blotting the sky.

lines.zh: 每一步都是一次灼烧
lines.en: Every step is one more scorching.

lines.zh: 火舌轻吐不息息，熔炉之心依旧炽。
lines.en: Fiery tongues flicker, the furnace heart still blazing hot.

lines.zh: 静默中蕴怒火，熔炉巨兽待时机。
lines.en: Silent with contained rage, the furnace beast awaits its chance.

lines.zh: 熔炉之火温不减，怒焰不灭其心坚。
lines.en: The furnace fire burns undiminished, its rage unquenched.

lines.zh: 熔炉巨兽安息时，怒焰不息在心间。
lines.en: The furnace beast rests, but its rage smolders in its heart.

lines.zh: 静默如石，怒焰如火，熔炉之魂永不灭。
lines.en: Stoic as stone, raging as fire, the furnace spirit endures.

lines.zh: 熔炉巨兽凝视天，怒焰腾腾映苍穹。
lines.en: The furnace beast gazes into the heavens, its flames leaping to the sky.

lines.zh: 熔岩之心永燃烧，怒焰不息在体内。
lines.en: The furnace heart burns forever, its rage never ceasing inside.

lines.zh: 熔炉巨兽沉思中，怒焰如梦般燃烧。
lines.en: The furnace beast meditates, its rage burning like a dream.

lines.zh: 熔炉之息温不减，怒焰依旧在体内。
lines.en: The furnace breath remains hot, its rage still within.

lines.zh: 熔炉巨兽静如石，怒焰却在心中燃。
lines.en: The furnace beast is still as stone, but its rage burns within.

lines.zh: 你只是渺小凡人，熔炉巨兽怒火中。
lines.en: You're but a mere mortal in the furnace beast's fury.

lines.zh: 目光锁定你，熔炉巨兽怒火燃。
lines.en: Its gaze locks on you, the furnace beast's rage flaring up.

lines.zh: 熔炉巨兽目光锐，怒焰映你心。
lines.en: The furnace beast's sharp gaze pierces you, its rage in its flames.

lines.zh: 熔炉巨兽眼中火，怒焰映你身。
lines.en: The furnace beast's fiery eyes, its rage in your reflection.

lines.zh: 你不过是微不足道，熔炉巨兽怒焰中。
lines.en: You're but insignificant in the furnace beast's flames of fury.

lines.zh: 熔炉巨兽怒目视，你渺小如尘埃。
lines.en: The furnace beast's angry gaze, you're tiny as dust.

lines.zh: 熔炉巨兽怒目扫，你不过是蝼蚁。
lines.en: The furnace beast's angry gaze, you're but a tiny ant.

lines.zh: 熔炉巨兽怒焰映，你渺小如影子。
lines.en: The furnace beast's raging flames, you're small as a shadow.

lines.zh: 熔炉巨兽目光灼，你渺小如蝼蚁。
lines.en: The furnace beast's searing gaze, you're small as an ant.

lines.zh: 熔炉巨兽怒目射，你不过是一粒尘。
lines.en: The furnace beast's angry gaze, you're but a grain of dust.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声中，它的皮肤开始裂开。
lines.en: Sssss, its skin is cracking.

lines.zh: 灼热的痛苦穿透它的躯体。
lines.en: The heat pain runs through its body.

lines.zh: 它摇摇欲坠，伤口渗出血水。
lines.en: Its wounds bleed profusely.

lines.zh: 它的鳞片开始剥落，露出内部的焦黑。
lines.en: Its scales peel, revealing the burnt inside.

lines.zh: 它嘶嘶地喘息，伤口在扩大。
lines.en: It sssss, its wounds are growing.

lines.zh: 它的力量在消退，伤口在恶化。
lines.en: Its strength fades, its wounds worsen.

lines.zh: 它挣扎着站起，伤口在疼痛。
lines.en: It struggles to stand, in pain.

lines.zh: 它的皮肤被灼烧，露出红色的肉。
lines.en: Its skin burns, revealing red flesh.

lines.zh: 它嘶嘶地喘息，似乎难以维持。
lines.en: It sssss, struggling to keep going.

lines.zh: 它摇摇欲坠，似乎要倒下了。
lines.en: It staggers, seems to fall.

lines.zh: 炽焰兽盯着你，眼中闪烁着愤怒的光芒。
lines.en: The Furnace glares at you with angry eyes.

lines.zh: 它那巨大的身躯几乎遮住了天空。
lines.en: Its enormous body almost blocks the sky.

lines.zh: 炽焰兽的火焰吐息让你感到一阵灼热。
lines.en: The Furnace’s breath of flame leaves you scorched.

lines.zh: 它的叫声如雷鸣般震耳欲聋。
lines.en: Its roar is deafening like a thunderstrike.

lines.zh: 炽焰兽喜欢吞噬岩浆，火焰是它的食物。
lines.en: The Furnace feeds on lava, fire is its food.

lines.zh: 它在下界荒地深处寻找猎物。
lines.en: It roams the depths of the Nether Wastes in search of prey.

lines.zh: 炽焰兽的愤怒来自于未知的起源。
lines.en: The Furnace’s fury comes from its unknown origin.

lines.zh: 它掉落的熔火煤能让你在战斗中更强大。
lines.en: It drops molten coal, empowering you in battle.

lines.zh: 尝试靠近它会让你陷入危险。
lines.en: Approaching it puts you in danger.

lines.zh: 它的愤怒使它成为最危险的怪物之一。
lines.en: Its rage makes it one of the most dangerous creatures.

lines.zh: 炽焰兽的身躯撞上岩壁，火花四溅。
lines.en: The Furnace’s body crashes into the wall, sending sparks flying.

lines.zh: 它的巨大撞击震动了整个地牢。
lines.en: Its massive impact shakes the entire dungeon.

lines.zh: 炽焰兽的撞击足以摧毁石块。
lines.en: The Furnace’s collision can destroy stone.

lines.zh: 它的撞击使地面微微震动。
lines.en: Its collision causes the ground to tremble slightly.

lines.zh: 炽焰兽撞向岩壁，火焰溅起。
lines.en: The Furnace crashes into the wall, splashing flames.

lines.zh: 它的力量足以打破石壁。
lines.en: Its strength can break through stone walls.

lines.zh: 炽焰兽撞击墙壁，溅出火焰。
lines.en: The Furnace collides with the wall, spitting flames.

lines.zh: 它的力量使石块粉碎。
lines.en: Its power shatters the stone.

lines.zh: 炽焰兽的碰撞足以震撼地牢。
lines.en: The Furnace’s collision can rattle the dungeon.

lines.zh: 它强大的撞击在地面上留下痕迹。
lines.en: Its powerful collision leaves marks on the ground.

lines.zh: 炽焰兽的咆哮中充满求偶之意。
lines.en: The Furnace’s roar is filled with mating intent.

lines.zh: 它对同类发出威胁性的低吼。
lines.en: It emits a threatening growl at its kind.

lines.zh: 炽焰兽用火焰吸引配偶。
lines.en: The Furnace uses flames to attract a mate.

lines.zh: 它怒吼着，求偶心切。
lines.en: It roars, eager to mate.

lines.zh: 炽焰兽的求偶叫声震动了洞穴。
lines.en: The Furnace’s mating call shakes the cave.

lines.zh: 它在岩壁上喷出火焰以示吸引。
lines.en: It sprays flames on the wall to attract a mate.

lines.zh: 炽焰兽发出求偶的嘶吼。
lines.en: The Furnace emits a mating snarl.

lines.zh: 它在洞穴中寻找配偶。
lines.en: It searches the cave for a mate.

lines.zh: 炽焰兽的求偶行为充满愤怒。
lines.en: The Furnace’s mating behavior is filled with rage.

lines.zh: 它的求偶叫声如同愤怒的怒吼。
lines.en: Its mating call is a roar of rage.

lines.zh: 熔火煤散发着温暖的光芒。
lines.en: The molten coal glows warmly.

lines.zh: 我吞下这煤炭，感到力量涌动。
lines.en: I swallow the coal and feel power surge.

lines.zh: 这块煤炭有股灼热的气息。
lines.en: This coal has a searing presence.

lines.zh: 熔火煤能让我在战斗中更加强大。
lines.en: Molten coal makes me stronger in battle.

lines.zh: 我找到了可以增强我的宝物。
lines.en: I found a treasure to enhance me.

lines.zh: 这煤炭在火焰中发出微光。
lines.en: This coal glows faintly in the flame.

lines.zh: 熔火煤在黑暗中为我指引方向。
lines.en: Molten coal guides me in the darkness.

lines.zh: 我必须将这块煤炭带回巢穴。
lines.en: I must take this coal back to my lair.

lines.zh: 这块煤炭能帮我度过难关。
lines.en: This coal will help me survive.

lines.zh: 它发出的光芒驱散了恐惧。
lines.en: Its light dispels fear.

lines.zh: 那声音是属于我的，只有我。
lines.en: That voice is mine, mine alone.

lines.zh: 我已经锁定了我的猎物。
lines.en: I've locked onto my prey.

lines.zh: 感受到我的愤怒了吗？
lines.en: Can you feel my rage?

lines.zh: 我要让世界颤抖。
lines.en: I will shake the world.

lines.zh: 我的怒火无人能挡。
lines.en: My fury cannot be stopped.

lines.zh: 岩浆顺着我的背流下来。
lines.en: Lava runs down my back.

lines.zh: 这世界再无我惧怕之物。
lines.en: This world has nothing to fear.

lines.zh: 让恐惧成为你的同伴。
lines.en: Let fear be your companion.

lines.zh: 我是这片荒地最愤怒的一只。
lines.en: I am the angriest thing on these wastes.

lines.zh: 整片下界荒地都在烧。
lines.en: The whole nether waste is burning.

lines.zh: 下界荒地没有别的主宰
lines.en: The Nether Wastes have no other master.

lines.zh: 最大的一只，就是我
lines.en: The largest of them all, that is me.

lines.zh: 你踩进了我的灰烬
lines.en: You have stepped into my ash.

lines.zh: 愤怒没有来由，也不需要
lines.en: My rage has no cause, and needs none.

lines.zh: 它的怒火将烧毁一切。
lines.en: Its rage will burn everything.

lines.zh: 让我看看你的恐惧。
lines.en: Let me see your fear.

lines.zh: 你会为今天的事后悔。
lines.en: You'll regret this today.

lines.zh: 传说野兽里，我最大最怒。
lines.en: Biggest and angriest of the legendary beasts.

lines.zh: 你逃不掉的，你会被吞噬。
lines.en: You cannot escape, you will be consumed.

lines.zh: 下界荒地最凶的那只，就是我。
lines.en: The fiercest beast of the Nether Wastes is me.

lines.zh: 享受这最后的呼吸吧。
lines.en: Enjoy your last breath.

lines.zh: 你的命运就在这一刻。
lines.en: Your fate is now.

lines.zh: 我会让你尝到恐惧的滋味。
lines.en: I'll let you taste fear.

lines.zh: 你的反抗毫无意义。
lines.en: Your resistance is futile.

lines.zh: 先烧断你的退路
lines.en: First I burn away your way back.

lines.zh: 熔火顺着地面爬过去
lines.en: Molten fire crawls along the ground.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁会先化
lines.en: The iron on you will melt first.

lines.zh: 这一口要吞下整片影子
lines.en: This bite will swallow the whole shadow.

lines.zh: 嘶吼怒吼！
lines.en: Roar loudly!

lines.zh: 炽热之息！
lines.en: Scorching breath!

lines.zh: 铁蹄践踏！
lines.en: Iron hooves stomp!

lines.zh: 熔岩喷吐！
lines.en: Lava spits out!

lines.zh: 我的拳头砸下，地面裂开。
lines.en: My fist falls and the ground splits.

lines.zh: 炙热的爪击！
lines.en: Blazing claws strike!

lines.zh: 岩浆洪流！
lines.en: Lava flood!

lines.zh: 烈焰之吻！
lines.en: Kiss of flame!

lines.zh: 怒火中烧！
lines.en: Fury burns!

lines.zh: 灰烬风暴席卷而来！
lines.en: An ash storm sweeps in!

lines.zh: 熔核炸裂，灼浪扑面！
lines.en: My molten core bursts, and heat slaps your face!

lines.zh: 一脚踩成一片焦土！
lines.en: One stomp, and it is scorched earth!

lines.zh: 火光吞没你的视线！
lines.en: Firelight swallows your sight!

lines.zh: 余烬小兵，一起上！
lines.en: Ember minions, all at once!

lines.zh: 裂隙中诞生！
lines.en: Born from a fissure!

lines.zh: 深渊之底！
lines.en: Bottom of the abyss!

lines.zh: 熔炉之灵！
lines.en: Furnace spirit!

lines.zh: 黑暗深处！
lines.en: Darkness's depths!

lines.zh: 传说里最大最凶的那只，是我。
lines.en: The biggest, fiercest legend beast is me.

lines.zh: 愤怒之焰！
lines.en: Fury's flame!

lines.zh: 炽热熔岩！
lines.en: Scalding lava!

lines.zh: 烈焰之影！
lines.en: Shadow of flame!

lines.zh: 燃烧之地！
lines.en: Burning place!

lines.zh: 熔炉中心！
lines.en: Furnace center!

lines.zh: 荒地裂开，我爬出来
lines.en: The waste splits, and I climb out.

lines.zh: 没人知道我为何醒来
lines.en: No one knows why I woke.

lines.zh: 火焰开始侵蚀它的皮肤。
lines.en: The flames are eating its skin.

lines.zh: 它从高处摔下，着地时发出沉重的声响。
lines.en: It falls from height, landing with a heavy thud.

lines.zh: 它在水里挣扎，逐渐沉入。
lines.en: It struggles in water, sinking.

lines.zh: 爆炸的冲击波撕裂它的皮肉。
lines.en: The shock wave rips its flesh.

lines.zh: 它被射中的地方开始流血。
lines.en: The place hit starts bleeding.

lines.zh: 它的身体开始扭曲变形。
lines.en: Its body twists and distorts.

lines.zh: 它的力量逐渐消退，虚弱地挣扎。
lines.en: Its strength fades, struggling weakly.

lines.zh: 闪电劈中它，烧灼它的皮肤。
lines.en: Lightning strikes, burning its skin.

lines.zh: 它跌入虚空，消失不见。
lines.en: It falls into the void, vanishing.
